historical_comparison_caveat: Historical runs used direct or provider-specific endpoints. Current OpenRouter runs intentionally leave provider selection unset, so provider, weights, quantization, serving code, or reasoning wrapper may vary; historical provider fields are recorded only as metadata. Within-run anchor contrasts remain interpretable.
